name: Check-in desk
adds: Passengers buy their tickets here: stand behind the desk to check them in

name: Gate 1
adds: A stand for a propeller plane: open the gate, then clear it for take-off

name: Fuel truck
adds: Planes fill up before they leave and fly further: +30% on every flight

name: Lounge seats
adds: Somewhere to sit by the gates: passengers wait far longer at check-in, and more come

name: Gate 2
adds: A second stand: two planes on the ground at once, and many more passengers

name: Check-in agent
adds: Checks passengers in for you, all day long

name: Baggage belt and cart
adds: Cases come out on the belt: carry them to each plane, for +30% on every flight

name: Ground handler
adds: Loads the cases and fuels the planes for you

name: Ramp dispatcher
adds: Opens the gates and waves each flight off once it's ready, so the airport earns while you're away (step on as the ring closes yourself for a perfect take-off)

name: Sky Café
adds: Passengers stop for a coffee on their way to the gate. Stand behind the counter to serve them

name: Gate 3 and the new wing
adds: The terminal grows: a new wing with a security lane, and a jet bridge to Gate 3. Jets carry twice the passengers

name: Catering kitchen
adds: Meals for the jets (each one pays more with its meals aboard) and sandwiches for the café. Carry the trays from the hatch

name: Fuel crew
adds: Fuels every plane for you, so the ground handler only has the cases to load

name: Duty-free shop
adds: Jet passengers shop for perfume and watches once they are through security

name: Catering runner
adds: Carries the kitchen's trays to the café and out to the jets

name: Runway lights
adds: The airport flies through the night: after dark the lights come on, and night flights pay more

name: Shop assistants
adds: A barista at the café and a clerk at duty-free, so the shops take money while you are busy elsewhere

name: Gate 4 and the east pier
adds: A stand for the wide-bodies (36 seats each) with a pier of its own for their lounge

name: Control tower
adds: Choose which flight lands next: a rich charter, an ordinary flight or a quick hop. And now and then, fog

name: Shuttle station
adds: A bus brings passengers in by the busload, enough to fill the wide-bodies

name: Mogul Air
adds: Your own airline: a plane in your colours flies the routes you choose and comes home with the takings, and souvenirs

name: VIP lounge
adds: A private jet stand: now and then a celebrity flies in with wishes to grant, for big tips

name: Bag sorter
adds: Cases go from the belt straight into every plane's hold, on belt loaders

name: Tower controller
adds: Picks the best-paying flight to land next whenever you haven't chosen one

name: Marshal
adds: Guides every plane onto its stand, for the parking bonus on every flight

name: Cargo apron
adds: A cargo shed and a stand for freighters: carry crates from the dock to the loader at the freighter's door

name: Cargo crew
adds: Loads every freighter from the dock for you

name: Maintenance hangar
adds: Mogul Air's planes wear with every trip: worn ones come home to the hangar to be serviced, and fly better after

name: Mechanic
adds: Services worn planes in the hangar for you

name: Mogul Air's second plane
adds: A second plane in your colours, flying routes of its own

name: Second runway
adds: Planes take off from a runway of their own while the first takes the landings: more flights, shorter waits

name: Jet wash
adds: Airlines book their jets in for a wash: a gantry of brushes, foam and water, and a fee for every one

name: Airport manager
adds: Keeps the whole airport earning in full while you're away
